All four rejections/corrections are addressed, verified, and honestly reported.

## Followup round — three rejections + the false terminal-safety claim, all addressed

**Item 1 — unreadable frontier no longer fail-open.** `predecessorsAcknowledged` and both wrappers now return **false** (defer; WAL/blob preserved, seen released) on closed/fault/lost-ownership/missing-getter, and the `arrival<=1` short-circuit is taken only *after* the journal is confirmed readable+owned — a first arrival on an unusable journal is deferred, not bypassed. Diagnostic counter `l0_ordering_frontier_unavailable`. New negative tests: `UnreadableFrontierFailsClosed`, `MissingJournalGetterFailsClosed`, `UnreadableFrontierNoPublication` (asserts no observer publication).

**Item 2 — host-id exception reverted.** `orderingApplies` removed; **every** leased event is ordered. This re-breaks `TestCarriedDefect_SP08D2` **by design** — I preserved its failure (recorded), did *not* re-fixture it or change sessions, and named the exact steps main must apply (replay-and-ACK the cut predecessor `readToken` before asserting `laterToken`'s frontier/supersession, same session) in the work report.

**Item 3 — look-ahead no longer wedges.** Replaced "stop at the bound" (which re-read the same prefix forever) with "keep scanning to EOF, bounded memory": `orderingLookaheadBound` caps buffered deferred requests and `orderingProcessedCap` caps the roll-forward map; overflow entries are neither buffered nor recorded and rely on the durable committed frontier to be absorbed on a later pass. New synthetic `DrainReversedPrefixBeyondBufferBoundDoesNotWedge` (1027 > bound, converges in a few passes, deferred count exceeds the bound) + per-session-independence + mid-pass-cancellation tests.

**Item 4 — my terminal-safety claim was FALSE; corrected and returned to main.** A delivery leased on one pass and **denied on retry** (physical-scope recheck of a path that became an escaping symlink) orphans its lease, blocking the session's later arrivals. The drain now detects a leased-then-refused line (`leaseHeld` by nonce, **no create**) and **preserves it pending** — no forged ACK, no denied bytes, no lease reassignment. `LeasedDenyOnRetryPreservedPending` pins it (counted, unacknowledged, spool retained, nothing published, successor still blocked). The work report names the **minimal journal completion hook main must supply** (a `completeTerminally(nonce)`-style record distinct from acknowledgement, in delivery_lease/seal) — I did not add it (main owns the ack-contract/journal).

**Recorded runs** (`dist/v6-remediation/runs/`, actual Go exit status, unique IDs, selected ordering/drain names — not the costly `TestDeliveryJournal`/history sweep):

- `delivery-order-followup-drain-regression` — `TestDrain|TestCarriedDefect_SP08D3` — **PASS** (drainFile rewrite didn't regress the drain path)
- `delivery-order-followup-sp08d2-expected-fail` — **FAIL by design** (preserved)
